title: openmls fork: virtual-clients-draft feature does not compile
description: Found during .4.73. Fork commit e045d7184 (feat: optional PublicGroup lifetime check) gave a verify(...) call a 4th argument, but creation.rs:1026 (virtual-clients-draft path) still passes 3, so 'cargo test -p openmls -F virtual-clients-draft' fails to build at fork HEAD 1f3f1b4bf. mimid does not enable the feature. Fix needs a fork commit (Mark's OK). Until fixed, the .4.73 virtual-client delete move has no committed test (exercised once with a temporary local fix: 522 passed).
